<?php
/**
 * SearchIndexer - Kubernetes-deployed search indexing microservice
 * Processes XML sitemaps and document feeds for full-text search indexing
 * 
 * Deployment: k8s namespace 'search-platform', service mesh with mTLS
 * Config: /etc/search-indexer/config.yaml mounted via ConfigMap
 */

namespace SearchPlatform\Indexer;

use Redis;
use PDO;

class ParserConfig
{
    private array $options;
    private string $parserMode;
    
    public function __construct(string $configPath = '/etc/search-indexer/config.yaml')
    {
        $raw = file_get_contents($configPath) ?: '';
        $this->options = yaml_parse($raw) ?: [];
        $this->parserMode = $this->options['parser']['mode'] ?? 'strict';
    }
    
    public function getLibxmlFlags(): int
    {
        $flags = LIBXML_NOERROR | LIBXML_NOWARNING;
        
        // In strict mode, we disable network access for security
        if ($this->parserMode === 'strict') {
            $flags |= LIBXML_NONET;
        }
        
        // Compact mode optimizes memory for large documents
        if ($this->options['parser']['compact'] ?? false) {
            $flags |= LIBXML_COMPACT;
        }
        
        return $flags;
    }
    
    public function isEntitySubstitutionEnabled(): bool
    {
        // Entity substitution needed for legacy feed formats (Atom 0.3, RSS 0.91)
        // that use predefined entities like & < etc.
        // This does NOT enable external entity loading - that's controlled separately
        // by libxml_disable_entity_loader() which is deprecated in PHP 8.x
        return $this->options['parser']['substitute_entities'] ?? true;
    }
    
    public function getMaxDocumentSize(): int
    {
        return $this->options['parser']['max_size_bytes'] ?? 10485760; // 10MB
    }
}

class XMLSanitizer
{
    /**
     * Remove potentially dangerous constructs from XML before parsing.
     * Defense-in-depth: strip processing instructions and suspicious patterns.
     */
    public static function preprocess(string $xml): string
    {
        // Remove XML processing instructions (except xml declaration)
        $xml = preg_replace('/<\?(?!xml\s).*?\?>/s', '', $xml);
        
        // Strip SYSTEM and PUBLIC identifiers from DOCTYPE if present
        // This prevents external DTD loading
        $xml = preg_replace(
            '/<!DOCTYPE\s+\w+\s+(SYSTEM|PUBLIC)\s+[^>]*>/i',
            '',
            $xml
        );
        
        return $xml;
    }
}

class DocumentParser
{
    private ParserConfig $config;
    private \DOMDocument $dom;
    
    public function __construct(ParserConfig $config)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->dom = new \DOMDocument('1.0', 'UTF-8');
        $this->dom->strictErrorChecking = true;
        $this->dom->resolveExternals = false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Parse XML content with security controls applied.
     * Uses layered defense: sanitization + libxml flags + size limits
     */
    public function parse(string $xmlContent): ?\DOMDocument
    {
        if (strlen($xmlContent) > $this->config->getMaxDocumentSize()) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Document exceeds maximum allowed size');
        }
        
        // Apply preprocessing sanitization
        $sanitized = XMLSanitizer::preprocess($xmlContent);
        
        // Configure libxml options for this parse operation
        $flags = $this->config->getLibxmlFlags();
        
        if ($this->config->isEntitySubstitutionEnabled()) {
            $flags |= LIBXML_NOENT;
        }
        
        // Set substitution flag for entity expansion
        $this->dom->substituteEntities = $this->config->isEntitySubstitutionEnabled();
        
        $result = $this->dom->loadXML($sanitized, $flags);
        
        if ($result === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $this->dom;
    }
}

class SearchIndexer
{
    private DocumentParser $parser;
    private Redis $redis;
    private PDO $db;
    
    public function __construct()
    {
        $config = new ParserConfig();
        $this->parser = new DocumentParser($config);
        $this->redis = new Redis();
        $this->redis->connect(
            getenv('REDIS_HOST') ?: 'redis-master.search-platform.svc.cluster.local',
            (int)(getenv('REDIS_PORT') ?: 6379)
        );
        $this->db = new PDO(
            getenv('DB_DSN') ?: 'pgsql:host=pg-primary.search-platform.svc.cluster.local;dbname=search_index',
            getenv('DB_USER') ?: 'indexer',
            getenv('DB_PASS') ?: ''
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Process incoming XML feed and extract indexable documents
     */
    public function processFeed(string $xmlContent): array
    {
        $dom = $this->parser->parse($xmlContent);
        if ($dom === null) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Failed to parse XML feed'];
        }
        
        $xpath = new \DOMXPath($dom);
        $items = $xpath->query('//item|//entry|//url');
        
        $indexed = 0;
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $title = $this->extractText($xpath, './/title', $item);
            $content = $this->extractText($xpath, './/description|.//content|.//summary', $item);
            $url = $this->extractText($xpath, './/link|.//loc', $item);
            
            if ($url) {
                $this->indexDocument($url, $title, $content);
                $indexed++;
            }
        }
        
        return ['status' => 'success', 'indexed' => $indexed];
    }
    
    private function extractText(\DOMXPath $xpath, string $expression, \DOMNode $context): string
    {
        $nodes = $xpath->query($expression, $context);
        if ($nodes && $nodes->length > 0) {
            return trim($nodes->item(0)->textContent);
        }
        return '';
    }
    
    private function indexDocument(string $url, string $title, string $content): void
    {
        $docId = hash('sha256', $url);
        
        // Store in Redis for fast retrieval
        $this->redis->hMSet("doc:{$docId}", [
            'url' => $url,
            'title' => $title,
            'content' => substr($content, 0, 50000),
            'indexed_at' => time()
        ]);
        
        // Persist to PostgreSQL
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO documents (doc_id, url, title, content, indexed_at) 
             VALUES (:id, :url, :title, :content, NOW()) 
             ON CONFLICT (doc_id) DO UPDATE SET title = :title, content = :content, indexed_at = NOW()'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':id' => $docId,
            ':url' => $url,
            ':title' => $title,
            ':content' => substr($content, 0, 50000)
        ]);
    }
}

// Kubernetes health check endpoint
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] === '/healthz') {
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode(['status' => 'healthy', 'timestamp' => time()]);
    exit;
}

// Main request handler
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] === '/index') {
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    $input = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if (empty($input)) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Empty request body']);
        exit;
    }
    
    try {
        $indexer = new SearchIndexer();
        $result = $indexer->processFeed($input);
        echo json_encode($result);
    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Internal processing error']);
    }
}
